correctness.rationale: With ordered magnitudes s1>=s2>=s3 and q=s1+s2+s3, positivity reduces up to Bell symmetry to s1+s2-s3<=1. Writing y=s2,z=s3 yields exactly (q-1)/2<=z<=q/3 and z<=y<=(q-z)/2. D_G=(y^2+z^2)/3. The minimum occurs at y=z and smallest z; for the maximum y=(q-z)/2 and convexity leaves endpoint z values. Their difference crosses at q=15/13, i.e. F=9/13. Connectedness and continuity give every intermediate value. The exact-rational verifier independently checks a Bell-probability grid and both extremal families.
